text_block_list.text:
Right down to the very, very end of the 
year. It kept us waiting quite a while, 
but—
That day finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You idiot! Don't open your eyes, Trainer. 
We're all gonna watch it together!"

Yes, this is inside the base. We 
blindfolded ourselves to enter, keeping 
our eyes closed so we can all take our 
first look together.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text: Here goes... Three!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Zero--!!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, look at this... Hahaha! It turned 
out just as ordered, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Look over here! Devouring jet-black 
diamonds and roaring to life, the steam 
engine!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Our bow will pierce right through 
formidable foes, monsters, and even 
reality itself as we charge endlessly 
forward!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, there's no need to worry 
anymore! As long as we have this cabin, no 
one! No one will ever bother us again!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You can't tear us apart! Laugh, laugh, 
laugh!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You tell me to laugh... *sniff*... but 
you're crying too, Tap...!"

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! We finally managed to get 
our dream spot, too. Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah. But... we can rest easy now.
Yeah. But... we can rest easy now.

text_block_list.text:
—A cabin-style base. A room modeled after 
a pirate ship, just as Tap Dance City 
envisioned.

Starting today, in this place we finally 
won for ourselves, we can all live in 
peace.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tap. From now on, I can learn running 
tips from you here too, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'll hammer it into you till you 
get it! No matter how many hours we stay, 
they won't kick us out anyway.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Then could you teach me English too~? 
Tap's, you know, a total negative, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm native, native. Okay, though a bit of 
a Kentucky accent might slip in, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, that's that! Now we'll never have 
to feel miserable again."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Today, we're celebrating setting sail 
right away! Everyone, break open all the 
food you brought with ya—!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

The memorable launch ceremony for our 
base. That joyful feast—

It went on and on, seemingly forever. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Tap!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: "See you tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Aah!

And so, Tap Dance City and I were left 
alone together—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Freedom...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, it got me thinking. Freedom is—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I guess having a place to return to is 
something you only truly appreciate once 
you have one.
"Now that we've secured this base, we—"

I can go anywhere. And I can come back 
whenever I want, totally free.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Navigator! We've secured our 
ship. Next year...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Where should we head next?! Our ocean is 
limitless!
